How to review
  1. Enter your reviewer name and drop the package ZIP onto the home page, or open its extracted folder. Filter by segment duration, then Random / Difficult. Unclassified means the source did not provide a sampling category.
  2. On a five-second page, click near a red marker to remove it; click an unmarked QRS peak to add it. To move a peak, remove the old marker and add it at the correct native sample. No automatic snapping or RR smoothing is applied.
  3. For unreadable data, select Cannot reliably read, then click the interval start and end. Return to Edit peaks to continue marking.
  4. Click Confirm page & save after checking each page. Confirm every page before choosing Complete window.
  5. Download progress backups regularly. Download annotations ZIP and return it to the research team.
Use the same package and reviewer name to resume. Different reviewers save separate work. This static site has no shared account database or access-code sign-in. It does not sync with the local review server.
Task-package descriptions are shown as supplied by the team. Assisted packages show editable suggestions; blind packages do not. Do not adjust real peaks merely to make RR intervals regular. No beat-type classification is required.
Files, native sample indices, task IDs and export formats remain compatible with existing R-peak packages and .ecgprogress backups. Clearing browser storage or using private browsing may lose progress; keep a downloaded backup.
